name: Soku Iki Bishonure Athlete! ~Shiofuki Zecchou Suru Athlete Heroine-tachi~
original_name: 即イキびしょぬれアスリート！ ～潮吹き絶頂するアスリートヒロインたち～
source: Protagonist is a former college volleyball player who had to quit due to injury, and ends up getting trained in, and giving massages to various sportswomen.
translation: 主人公曾是大学排球选手，因受伤不得不退役，后来开始接受训练，并为各种女运动员按摩。
